premise: PR #9 evidence can change materially, but synchronize-event count is not evidence-state change and does not justify one Work-mode run per push.

old_job.title: Reconcile PO-03 evidence
old_job.fanout: one full run per matching event

replacement_job.title: Batch PO-03 evidence
replacement_job.job_shape: one time-bounded observation window; deduplicate all commits/checks/comments/reviews; at most one evidence decision and one SO-02 commit per run; no write without material delta
replacement_job.cost_shape: at most one Work-mode run per hour instead of one per PR event; zero repository writes and no notification when evidence state is unchanged
replacement_job.idempotency: last durable SCF-01 observation plus immutable commit/check/comment/review identifiers
